# Ambu Bar LLC

Official site: https://ambubar.vercel.app

Ambu Bar is a retired ambulance converted into a mobile beverage bar serving weddings, festivals, private parties, fundraisers, and corporate events across Pennsylvania and nearby communities.

Primary services:
- Mobile beverage bar
- Beer and wine service
- Mocktails and coffee
- Dirty Soda bar
- Weddings, celebrations, festivals, and pop-ups

Public pages:
- Home and services: https://ambubar.vercel.app/
- Events: https://ambubar.vercel.app/#events
- Contact and booking: https://ambubar.vercel.app/contact
- Online store: https://ambubar.vercel.app/merchandise

Verify current services, pricing, event information, and availability against the live website.
